                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'In modern web applications, managing background scheduled jobs and monitoring their execution status is a common requirement. In this task, you will build a self-contained scheduled tasks dashboard using Qwik (Qwik City) and SQLite.\n'[39m +

                    [32m"      // For example ['better-sqlite3'] if you use that in server functions.\n"[39m +
                    [32m'      exclude: [],\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    },\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +

                    [32m"        // Don't cache the server response in dev mode\n"[39m +

                    [32m'import { guessLocale } from "compiled-i18n";\n'[39m +
                    [32m'import type { RequestHandler } from "@builder.io/qwik-city";\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Handle incoming requests to determine and set the appropriate locale.\n'[39m +
                    [32m" * This function checks for a 'locale' query parameter, then a `locale` cookie,\n"[39m +
                    [32m" * and finally falls back to the 'Accept-Language' header.\n"[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export const onRequest: RequestHandler = async ({\n'[39m +

                    [32m'  cookie,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  headers,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  locale,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}) => {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  // Allow overriding locale with query param `locale`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  if (query.has("locale")) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    const newLocale = guessLocale(query.get("locale"));\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    cookie.delete("locale");\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    cookie.set("locale", newLocale, {});\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    locale(newLocale);\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  } else {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    // Choose locale based on cookie or accept-language header\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    const maybeLocale =\n'[39m +
                    [32m'      cookie.get("locale")?.value || headers.get("accept-language");\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    locale(guessLocale(maybeLocale));\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Only create commits when requested by the user. If unclear, ask first. When the user asks you to create a new git commit, follow these steps carefully:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Git Safety Protocol:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER update the git config\n'[39m +
            [32m"- NEVER run destructive git commands (push --force, reset --hard, checkout ., restore ., clean -f, branch -D) unless the user explicitly requests these actions. Taking unauthorized destructive actions is unhelpful and can result in lost work, so it's best to ONLY run these commands when given direct instructions \n"[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER skip hooks (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, etc) unless the user explicitly requests it\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER run force push to main/master, warn the user if they request it\n'[39m +

Instead, after hook failure, fix the issue, re-stage, and create a NEW commit\n'[39m +
            [32m'- When staging files, prefer adding specific files by name rather than using "git add -A" or "git add .", which can accidentally include sensitive files (.env, credentials) or large binaries\n'[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER commit changes unless the user explicitly asks you to. It is VERY IMPORTANT to only commit when explicitly asked, otherwise the user will feel that you are being too proactive\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. You can call multiple tools in a single response.             [32m"  - Run a git log command to see recent commit messages, so that you can follow this repository's commit message style.\n"[39m +

            [32m'  - Summarize the nature of the changes (eg. new feature, enhancement to an existing feature, bug fix, refactoring, test, docs, etc.).             [32m'4. If the commit fails due to pre-commit hook changes, retry the commit ONCE to include these automated changes. If the commit succeeds but you notice that files were modified by the pre-commit hook, you MUST amend your commit to include them.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Important notes:\n'[39m +

                    [32m'import { guessLocale } from "compiled-i18n";\n'[39m +
                    [32m'import type { RequestHandler } from "@builder.io/qwik-city";\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Handle incoming requests to determine and set the appropriate locale.\n'[39m +
                    [32m" * This function checks for a 'locale' query parameter, then a `locale` cookie,\n"[39m +
                    [32m" * and finally falls back to the 'Accept-Language' header.\n"[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export const onRequest: RequestHandler = async ({\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  query,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  cookie,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  headers,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  locale,\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}) => {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  // Allow overriding locale with query param `locale`\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  if (query.has("locale")) {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    const newLocale = guessLocale(query.get("locale"));\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    cookie.delete("locale");\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    cookie.set("locale", newLocale, {});\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    locale(newLocale);\n'[39m +
                    [32m'  } else {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    // Choose locale based on cookie or accept-language header\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    const maybeLocale =\n'[39m +
                    [32m'      cookie.get("locale")?.value || headers.get("accept-language");\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    locale(guessLocale(maybeLocale));\n'[39m +

                [32m"I'm currently focusing on the `/tasks` page, specifically how to implement the form and action buttons within Qwik. My immediate goal is to ensure a seamless user experience for rendering both the task list and the necessary interaction elements.\n"[39m +

                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m"I'm refining the task creation form and integrating action buttons for pause, resume, and trigger functionalities. Real-time updates are crucial, so I'm setting up an auto-refresh timer and ensuring reactive client-side state management with `useStore`.\n"[39m +

                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m"I've confirmed that using dynamic imports for server-side modules within `routeLoader$` is a robust strategy to prevent their inclusion in client-side bundles. I'm now proceeding to implement the `src/routes/tasks/index.tsx` file, focusing on standard Qwik input binding to a store using `value` and `onInput$`.\n"[39m +

              toolName: [32m'writeToFile'[39m,
              input: {
                path: [32m'src/routes/tasks/index.tsx'[39m,
                content: [32m'import { component$, useStore, useVisibleTask$, $, useSignal } from "@builder.io/qwik";\n'[39m +
                  [32m'import { routeLoader$, type DocumentHead } from "@builder.io/qwik-city";\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export const useTasksData = routeLoader$(async () => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const db = (await import("../../lib/db")).default;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const tasks = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks").all() as any[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const history = db.prepare(\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    "SELECT h.*, t.name as task_name FROM execution_history h JOIN tasks t ON h.task_id = t.id ORDER BY h.timestamp DESC LIMIT 50"\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  ).all() as any[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  return { tasks, history };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'});\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export default component$(() => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const initialData = useTasksData();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const isRefreshing = useSignal(false);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const state = useStore({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    tasks: initialData.value.tasks,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    history: initialData.value.history,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Form fields\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    newId: "",\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    newName: "",\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    newCommand: "",\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    newInterval: 10,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    newStatus: "ACTIVE" as "ACTIVE" | "PAUSED",\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    formError: "",\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    formSuccess: "",\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const refreshData = $(async () => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    isRefreshing.value = true;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const resTasks = await fetch("/api/tasks");\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (!resTasks.ok) return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const tasks = (await resTasks.json()) as any[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      state.tasks = tasks;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // Fetch history for each task and merge\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const allHistory: any[] = [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      for (const task of tasks) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const resHist = await fetch(`/api/tasks/${task.id}/history`);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        if (resHist.ok) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          const hist = (await resHist.json()) as any[];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          for (const h of hist) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            allHistory.push({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              ...h,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'              task_name: task.name,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'            });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // Sort combined history by timestamp descending\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      allHistory.sort(\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        (a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime()\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      );\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      state.history = allHistory.slice(0, 50);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      console.error("Error refreshing data:", err);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } finally {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      isRefreshing.value = false;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Auto-refresh every 3 seconds on the client\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  useVisibleTask$(() => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const timer = setInterval(() => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      refreshData();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }, 3000);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const handleSubmit = $(async (e: Event) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    e.preventDefault();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    state.formError = "";\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    state.formSuccess = "";\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const payload = {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      id: state.newId.trim(),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      name: state.newName.trim(),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      command: state.newCommand.trim(),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      interval_seconds: Number(state.newInterval),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      status: state.newStatus,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const res = await fetch("/api/tasks", {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        method: "POST",\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        body: JSON.stringify(payload),\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      if (!res.ok) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        const errData = (await res.json()) as any;\n'[39m +

            [32m'When using the newTask tool, the agentType parameter is optional. Leave it empty (None) to launch a generic sub agent, or specify one of the available agent types below to select a specialized agent.\n'[39m +
            [32m'Available agent types and the tools they have access to:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### browser\n'[39m +
            [32m'Web browser automation agent for navigating websites, interacting with pages, and extracting information. Uses agent-browser CLI for browser control, including headless sessions and optional local Chrome auto-connect.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### explore\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this agent to explore the codebase when you need to: understand project structure, find where features are implemented, locate specific functions or classes, analyze code patterns, investigate how something works, search for examples or usage, or gather information before making changes.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of questions this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "where is the authentication logic implemented"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "find all usages of the config parser"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "how does the ignore-walk module work"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### guide\n'[39m +
            [32m"A comprehensive guide for learning about Pochi's capabilities, features, and configuration.\n"[39m +
            [32m'This agent helps users understand how to use Pochi effectively, fetch documentation, and modify their config file (.pochi/config.jsonc) with proper confirmation.\n'[39m +
            [32m"**IMPORTANT: Any request to modify Pochi's configuration must be handled by this agent.**\n"[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Trigger examples:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- General info: "what can Pochi do?", "what agents/tools are available?", "how does Pochi work?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Configuration: "how do I configure Pochi?", "explain config options", "help me modify my config", "set up a new provider", "add an MCP server"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Help & feedback: "join the discord", "report a bug", "where can I get help?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### planner\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to formulate comprehensive, technical implementation strategies for feature development, system refactoring, or defect resolution.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent is strictly limited to planning and architectural design; it DOES NOT execute code modifications.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "create a plan to implement the user authentication feature"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "how should we refactor the database schema"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "design a solution for the memory leak issue"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### reviewer\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to perform code reviews and leave inline comments.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent can analyze code and create review comments on specific lines.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "review the code in src/auth"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "add review comments to this file"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "check this code and leave feedback"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Always include a reminder in your prompt to ensure the result will be submitted through the `attemptCompletion` tool.\n'[39m +
            [32m'If the task stops without submitting the result, it will return an error message.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'When NOT to use the newTask tool:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If you want to read a specific file path, use the readFile or globFiles tool instead of the newTask tool, to find the match more quickly\n'[39m +
            [32m'- If you are searching for a specific class definition like "class Foo", use the globFiles tool instead, to find the match more quickly\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Usage notes:\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. Launch multiple agents tools concurrently whenever possible to maximize performance; to do that, use a single message with multiple tool uses\n'[39m +
            [32m'2. When the agent is done, it will return a single message back to you. The result returned by the agent is not visible to the user. To show the user the result, you should send a text message back to the user with a concise summary of the result.\n'[39m +
            [32m'3. Each agent invocation is stateless. You will not be able to send additional messages to the agent, nor will the agent be able to communicate with you outside of its final report.
